Docket 1.3.108

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *The crawl is about twice as fast on a site that answers quickly.* Docket asked every
  site for four pages a second, whatever the server could take. It now starts at that
  pace and, while the site answers each request in under 0.4 seconds with no error,
  narrows the gap between requests by a quarter after every eight answers, down to
  0.1 seconds. A slow answer or a server error sends it back to the starting gap, and a
  429, a 503 or a dropped connection ends the speeding up for the rest of that crawl.
  A Crawl-delay in the site's robots.txt, and any delay you set above 0.25, are never
  narrowed. On one 152-page site the crawl took 43 seconds at the old pace and 22 at 0.1.
- *The outbound link check waits on twelve answers at a time, not six.* Each other
  site is still asked at its own pace; only the number of answers waited on at once
  changed.

99 checks across 13 areas.
